DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座の使い方についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to consult about using your bank account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から、給料の受取先に私の口座を使いたいと言われました。まだ番号を渡していません。了承する前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人給料受取への本人口座利用を了承前相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend said they want to use my account to receive their salary. I have not given them the number yet. I would like to consult before agreeing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want advice before agreeing to let a friend receive their salary in your own account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の給与ではなく、別の方の給与についてなのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So this is about another person’s salary, rather than your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。振り込まれたら私が引き出して渡してほしい、と言われています。私への支払いや贈り物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別人給与の引出受渡依頼で贈物でないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. They asked me to withdraw it after it is deposited and hand it to them. It is not a payment or gift to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you were asked to withdraw and hand over someone else’s salary, and it is not a gift.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その予定で利用できると、ここでお約束することはできません。担当へ詳しくお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot promise here that the account can be used that way. I will explain the details to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。友人の頼みだから手続きなしで使ってよい、と自分では決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人依頼だけで許可を判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I cannot decide myself that it is fine to use it without any procedures just because a friend asked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not decide whether it is permitted solely because a friend requested it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の口座の情報や利用について、担当の説明をお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please listen to the person in charge explain your account information and its use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 話を聞くまでは、口座の番号も通帳の写真も送りません。カードを友人へ貸すこともしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明まで口座情報画像を送らずカードも貸していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Until I hear the explanation, I will not send either the account number or a photo of the bankbook. I have not lent my friend my card either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not send account details or images before the explanation and have not lent your card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだご自身で了承なさっていないことを、担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge that you have not yet agreed yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人にもまだ了承できないと伝えます。本人が自分の給与を受け取る方法を相談することも考えてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未了承を友人へ伝え本人の受取方法相談を促すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my friend that I cannot agree yet. I will also ask them to consider consulting about how to receive their own salary themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your friend you have not agreed and encourage them to consult about receiving their own salary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの担当窓口で詳しく伺います。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Our designated counter will ask you for the details. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はお済みですね。何かございましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have already paid, correct? Is something wrong?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋の底に卵を入れてしまいました。上に米があるので、ここで詰め直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 米の下の卵を詰直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put the eggs at the bottom of the bag. The rice is on top, so I would like to repack them here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to repack the eggs underneath the rice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 横の袋詰め台をお使いください。まず米を取り出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use the packing table at the side. Can you take the rice out first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、台へ置きます。卵のパックを引き抜くと、上の物が落ちそうだったのでやめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先に米を出し無理な引抜きを避けたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I will put it on the table. I stopped trying to pull out the egg carton because the things on top looked likely to fall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will remove the rice first and avoided forcing the eggs out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 卵は、外から見て破損している様子がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do the eggs appear damaged from the outside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今見える範囲では割れていません。中まで確認したわけではないので、断定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外から見える卵は割れていないが中までは確認していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The ones I can see now are not broken. I have not checked inside, so I cannot say for certain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the eggs visible from outside are not broken, but you have not checked inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 上の物を移してから、パックを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Move the items on top before checking the carton.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 取り出せました。見える卵は割れていません。卵用に、軽い物だけを入れた別の袋を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 上を外し卵を別袋へ入れると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have taken it out. The eggs I can see are not broken. I will use a separate bag containing only light items for the eggs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you removed the items on top and will put the eggs in a separate bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の袋はお持ちですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さな布袋があります。米は元の袋、卵は布袋に分けました。台に忘れ物がないか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 米と卵を分け忘れ物確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a small cloth bag. I separated them: rice in the original bag and eggs in the cloth bag. I will check that I have left nothing on the table.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have separated the rice and eggs and will check for forgotten items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お荷物の準備ができましたらどうぞ。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go ahead once your bags are ready. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 清掃の担当をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the person in charge of the cleanup?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今日参加していますが、家から連絡があり、途中で帰る必要ができました。誰に伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃中の早退必要と連絡先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am participating today, but I received a message from home and now need to leave partway through. Who should I tell?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you need to leave the cleanup early and ask whom to contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 班の担当へお伝えください。今は、どちらの班で作業されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell your team leader. Which team are you working with now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 西の花壇の班です。受付で名前を書いているので、いなくなったと思われる前に連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 西花壇班と登録済みの所在連絡を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The west flowerbed team. I wrote my name at reception, so I want to let someone know before they think I have gone missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you belong to the west flowerbed team and want to report your whereabouts because you registered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当を呼びます。借りた道具はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will call the team leader. Have you borrowed any tools?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: トングを一本借りました。私物の手袋とは分けて、返してから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 借トング一本と私物手袋を分け返却すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I borrowed one pair of tongs. I will keep them separate from my own gloves, return them, and then leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separate the one borrowed pair of tongs from your own gloves and return them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが班の担当です。早く帰ることを直接お伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is your team leader. Please tell them directly that you are leaving early.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 申し訳ありませんが、今日はここで帰ります。私が集めたごみは班の指定した場所へ置きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当へ直接早退と収集ごみ所在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am sorry, but I will leave now today. I put the rubbish I collected in the place designated by the team.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the team leader directly in Japanese that you are leaving early and where the collected rubbish is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 道具をここでお返しいただき、担当が退出を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please return the tool here, and the leader will confirm your departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: トングを返しました。受付の名前も確認してもらったので、班にはもう戻らず帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: トング返却と名簿確認後退出を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I returned the tongs. They checked my name at reception too, so I will go home without returning to the team.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave after returning the tongs and having your name checked on the list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご連絡とご協力ありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for notifying us and for your help. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you waiting for a train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。携帯扇風機を使っていますが、少し音が大きいです。放送を聞きたいので、今は止めて待った方がよさそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 扇風機音で放送を聞きづらく停止しようと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am using a handheld fan, but it is a little loud. I want to hear the announcements, so it seems better to turn it off while I wait now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the fan noise makes announcements hard to hear and you intend to turn it off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 放送や周囲の音にも気を配ってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please pay attention to announcements and the sounds around you while waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 止めたら聞こえやすくなりました。今はかばんへしまっておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 停止で聞こえ方が変わりかばんへしまうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is easier to hear now that I have turned it off. I will put it in my bag for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that turning it off changed how well you could hear and you will put it in your bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 暑さで体調がつらいなどはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are you feeling unwell from the heat at all?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は大丈夫です。暑くなったら無理に立ち続けず、休める場所を係員に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現体調とつらければ休場所を尋ねると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am fine now. If I get too hot, I will not force myself to remain standing, but ask a staff member where I can rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese how you feel now and that you will ask for somewhere to rest if you feel unwell.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 水分を取る時も、足元にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please watch your footing when drinking water too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ここで水を飲んでから待ちます。次の列車の放送はもうありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水を飲み次の列車の放送があったか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will drink some water here before waiting. Has the announcement for the next train been made yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will drink water and ask whether the next train announcement has been made.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まもなく案内があります。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: There will be an announcement shortly. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 放送が聞こえました。扇風機をしまったまま乗り、車内で使いたくなったら周りの方への音も考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 放送確認し車内使用時も周囲音に配慮する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I heard the announcement. I will board with the fan still put away, and if I want to use it on the train, I will consider the noise for people around me too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you heard the announcement and will consider noise for others when using the fan on board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、どうぞお気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take care when boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような案内をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What sort of information would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来月こちらへ引っ越します。通勤で自転車を使いたいので、駅の近くに置ける場所の相談先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居前通勤用駅近駐輪相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am moving here next month. I want to commute by bicycle, so please tell me whom to consult about somewhere to park near the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese where to consult before moving about bicycle parking near the station for commuting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用したい場所や期間を、担当へ具体的にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell the person in charge specifically where and for how long you want to use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 毎日通勤に使いたいです。来月引っ越しますが、日付はまだ決まっていません。月単位の利用について相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転居日未定と毎日の通勤用途を説明し継続利用相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to use it for commuting every day. I am moving next month, but the date is not decided yet. Can I consult about monthly use?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the moving date is undecided and it is for daily commuting, and request advice about ongoing use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 料金や申込み、空き状況は、管理する窓口で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check fees, applications, and availability with the management counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。前に大きなかごが付いています。大きさによって使える場所が違うこともありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きい前かごが利用条件に影響するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. There is a large basket on the front. Can the size affect which spaces I can use?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether a large front basket affects the conditions of use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 特殊な大きさなどでしたら、利用先へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If it is an unusual size or similar, please check with the facility you intend to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、かごの幅を測ってから聞きます。窓口の連絡先を持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: かご寸法を測ると話し窓口連絡先を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will measure the width of the basket before asking. Can I take the counter’s contact details home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will measure the basket and ask for the counter’s contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 引っ越し予定と利用希望をまとめて、お問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please make your inquiry with a summary of your moving plans and desired use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来月から継続利用で、日付は未定とかごが大きいことを伝えます。相談先の案内を持ち帰って確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時期継続希望未定日寸法をまとめ相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will say I want ongoing use from next month, that the date is undecided, and that the basket is large. I will take the consultation contact information home and check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will summarize the timing, desire for ongoing use, undecided date, and dimensions when consulting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが管理窓口の案内です。それでは、ご準備を進めてください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the management counter information. Please go ahead with your preparations. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の準備について、ご不安な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any concerns about preparing for the examination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きい機械の音が苦手です。前に似た音で怖くなったので、始める前に検査担当の方へ話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 機械音が苦手で開始前検査担当へ相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have trouble with loud machine noises. A similar sound frightened me before, so I would like to tell the examination staff before we start.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that machine noise bothers you and you want to consult the examination staff before starting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのようなことが気になるか、教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me what concerns you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 音が聞こえると急に動いてしまいそうなことです。検査を必ず断ると決めたのではなく、対応を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 驚いて動く不安と拒否未決定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am worried that hearing the sound might make me move suddenly. I have not decided that I will definitely refuse the examination; I would like to discuss what can be done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your fear of moving when startled and that you have not decided to refuse.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へご希望を伝えます。音や途中の合図についても説明を聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will pass on your wishes to the staff. You can also hear an explanation of the noises and signals during the examination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どんな音がするかと、怖くなった時の合図を先に教えてもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 検査音の説明と困った時の合図を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It would help if they could first explain what sounds there will be and what signal to use if I become frightened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request in Japanese an explanation of examination sounds and a signal for when you have difficulty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使える対応を、担当と一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check with the staff what measures can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当の方に聞きます。耳を守る物など、検査中に使える物があれば知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 検査中に使える音への対応方法を担当へ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask them. I would like to know if there is anything I can use during the examination, such as something to protect my ears.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the staff in Japanese about measures for sound that can be used during the examination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が説明するまで、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait here until the staff explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待ちます。説明を聞いてから、受けることへの不安が残るかも正直に伝えます。無理に平気だと答えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後残る不安も正直に伝え平気と偽答しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait. After hearing the explanation, I will honestly say if I still feel anxious about undergoing it. I will not force myself to say I am fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will honestly report any remaining anxiety after the explanation and will not falsely say you are fine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 検査担当へお伝えしてきます。ご案内するまでここでお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will go and inform the examination staff. Please wait here until we guide you. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのようなことでお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知っている人から、怖い言葉のメッセージが届きました。返事をする前に相談したくて、画面をそのまま持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 怖い知人メッセージ受信後未返信で相談希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a message with frightening words from someone I know. I wanted to consult before replying, so I brought the screen as it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you received a frightening message from an acquaintance, have not replied, and want advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、その方は近くにいらっしゃいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここにはいません。今どこにいるかは知りません。こちらから会いに行って話をつけるつもりもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手不在所在不明で自己対決に行かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are not here. I do not know where they are now. I do not intend to go and meet them to settle things myself either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the person is absent, their whereabouts are unknown, and you will not go confront them yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届いた内容と時刻を、分かる範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me, as far as you know, what arrived and at what time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝八時ごろです。画面に「今夜お前の家へ行く」とあります。前にも会いたくないと伝えた人なので怖いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受信時刻と具体的な原文を示し怖い理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was around eight this morning. The screen says, “I am coming to your house tonight.” It frightens me because this is someone I previously told I did not want to meet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the receipt time and specific original message and explain why you are frightened. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在のご不安や、ほかの連絡も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also ask about your current concerns and any other contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は一人で家へ戻るのが怖いです。メッセージを消して気にしないようにするだけではなく、帰る前にどうすればよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単独帰宅不安を伝え帰宅前安全対応を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am afraid to go home alone now. Rather than just delete the message and try to ignore it, I want advice about what to do before going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your fear of going home alone and consult about safety measures before returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状況を確認し、安全について必要な案内をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the situation and provide the necessary safety guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今夜来ると書かれていますが、本当に来るかは分かりません。家にいる家族への連絡についても相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 来訪の不確実性と在宅家族への連絡の相談を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. It says they will come tonight, but I do not know whether they really will. I would also like to consult about contacting my family at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the uncertainty of their visit and ask about contacting family members at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今の内容を担当へ伝えます。ここでお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this information to the person in charge. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の方、こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Next person, please come over here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。子どもが急にトイレへ行きたくなりました。手紙はまだ渡していないので、今日は受付を離れてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子の急トイレで未受理手紙を持ち受付離脱可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me. My child suddenly needs the toilet. I have not handed over the letter yet, so may I leave the counter today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may leave reception with the unaccepted letter because your child urgently needs the toilet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお預かりしていませんので、お手紙をお持ちになって離れていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have not taken the letter yet, so you may take it with you and leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手紙を持って、子どもと一緒に行きます。戻ったら並び直しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子と手紙を持って離れ戻れば再度並ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will take the letter and go with my child. I will join the queue again when I return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave with your child and letter, then queue again if you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: トイレの場所は、こちらの案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check this information for the toilet location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内を見ました。用事が済んで戻れたら、列の最後に並び直します。子どもが疲れたら、今日の窓口利用はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 戻れば再並びし子疲なら窓口後日にすると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have looked at the directions. If I can return after we finish, I will join the back of the queue again. If my child is tired, I will give up using the counter today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will queue again if you return and leave the counter visit for another day if your child is tired.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 後での差出しについて、確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything you would like to check about sending it later?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。後でポストへ出せるようにしたいのですが、切手の料金はまだ確認していません。戻った時に聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後のポスト投函を考え未確認の切手料金を再来時に尋ねたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I would like to be able to put it in a postbox later, but I have not checked the postage yet. Could I ask when I come back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are considering posting it later and want to ask about the unchecked postage when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、戻られましたら料金と投函の準備を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, when you return, we will check the postage and preparations for posting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は子どもの用事を先にします。手紙をかばんへ入れ、差出し方法は落ち着いてから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子用事を優先し手紙収納後落着いて差出法確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: All right. I will put my child’s needs first today. I will put the letter in my bag and check how to send it once things have settled down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will prioritize your child, put away the letter, and check the sending method when you are settled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お手紙をお忘れなく。それでは、どうぞお子様とご一緒に。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do not forget your letter. Go ahead with your child, then. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 操作の途中でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble partway through the operation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手に塗ったクリームで画面が滑ってしまいました。何度も押す前に、一度手を拭いてから操作したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手クリームで操作滑り一度拭きたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The cream on my hands made them slip on the screen. Before pressing repeatedly, I would like to wipe my hands once and then operate it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that hand cream made your touch slip and you would like to wipe your hands first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いったん操作を止めましょう。画面の状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us stop the operation for now. I will check the screen’s state.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。一度押したつもりなのですが、次の画面へ進んでいるか見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一度押した後の画面進行を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I thought I pressed once; could you check whether it has moved to the next screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a check of whether the screen advanced after one press.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ次の確認へ進んでいません。手を拭く間、操作を中止できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: It has not yet advanced to the next confirmation. You can cancel the operation while wiping your hands.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中止しました。ハンカチで手を拭くので、少し待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 操作を中止し手を拭く時間を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have canceled it. Please wait a little while I wipe my hands with a handkerchief.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have canceled the operation and ask for time to wipe your hands.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 再開する時は、最初から内容を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: When restarting, please check the details from the beginning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もう一度最初から選びます。手を拭いたので、今度は画面を確認しながら進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再開時は最初から確認しながら選びたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will make the selections again from the start. Now that I have wiped my hands, I would like to proceed while checking the screen this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to select from the beginning while checking when you restart.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 画面に汚れが残っている場合は、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If any marks remain on the screen, please let us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 画面にも少し跡が残っています。清掃をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面の汚れを報告し清掃を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: There are a few marks left on the screen too. Could I ask you to clean it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the marks on the screen and request cleaning in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 清掃できる担当を呼んできます。今は操作をお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will call someone who can clean it. Please wait before operating it now. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かごの中のお荷物について、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the items in your basket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この瓶がかごの中で倒れました。割れていませんが、歩くたびに動くので、置き方を直してから買い物を続けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 倒れた未破損瓶が動くので置直し相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This bottle fell over in the basket. It is not broken, but it moves every time I walk, so I would like to adjust its position before continuing to shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the unbroken bottle that fell over keeps moving and ask about repositioning it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: かごをいったんこちらへ置いて、瓶の状態をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please set the basket down here for a moment and check the bottle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらへ置きます。口のところも底も、今のところひびは見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かごを置き瓶の口と底のひびの有無を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will put it here. For now, I cannot see any cracks at the mouth or the bottom.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Set down the basket and report in Japanese whether there are cracks at the bottle’s mouth and bottom.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 破損がありましたら、すぐお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: If there is any damage, please let us know immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 漏れもないようです。パンが下にあったので、つぶれる前に上へ移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 漏れを確認し瓶の下のパンを上へ移すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: There does not seem to be any leaking either. The bread was underneath, so I will move it to the top before it gets crushed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check for leakage and say in Japanese that you will move the bread from underneath the bottle to the top.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 重い商品で、ほかの商品をつぶさないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please take care not to crush other products with heavy ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。瓶を一つずつ立て、かごを傾けずに持ちます。詰め過ぎて安定しないなら、もう一つかごを使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 瓶直立運搬し詰過なら追加かご使用可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will stand the bottles upright one at a time and carry the basket without tilting it. If it is too full and unstable, may I use another basket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will carry the bottles upright and ask whether you may use another basket if overfilled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 空いたかごをお使いいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may use an empty basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: もう一つ使います。瓶は一方、パンはもう一方へ入れました。どちらもゆっくり運んでレジへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 瓶パンを二かご分離して安定運搬会計へ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use one more. I put the bottles in one and the bread in the other. I will carry both slowly to the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separate bottles and bread into two baskets and carry them steadily to checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ足元にもお気をつけください。それでは、お会計へお進みください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch your footing too. Then proceed to checkout. Thank you.
